About me

I am an International Relations graduate from Universiti Malaysia Sarawak with a strong interest in public policy, international trade and international economic relations.

During my internship at Malaysia's Ministry of Investment, Trade and Industry (MITI), I gained practical exposure to Malaysia–China bilateral economic relations, policy research, government procedures and official engagements.

I am particularly interested in understanding how governments, businesses and international actors navigate economic cooperation and competing interests.
